description: Urban Waste Water Treatment Directive, Agglomerations reported under UWWTD data call 2023 - PUBLIC FINAL VERSION, Oct. 2025 is a dataset listed in EEA SDI - geospatial data catalogue, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by water.discomap.eea.europa.eu. UWWTD Agglomerations, Oct. 2025 is one of the datasets produced within the frame of the reporting under 12th UWWTD Art.15 reporting period (UWWTD data call 2023). The Urban Waste Water Treatment Directive (UWWTD) (91/271/EEC) obliges Member States to report data on the implementation of the Directive upon request from the European Commission bi-annually. Coverage: Europe. The listing shows 4 download or service links in WMS, GDB. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-eea-sdi.
